thought.text: Key 20 **habis**, 21 dan 22 masih hidup. Sekarang saya uji dugaan utama: **apakah LightVela mengirim prompt besar** tiap pesan.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
K="nmk_live_FtVn4vczCTzAEeZYSQYF65DSwerrKBsPbuAQJx1l"
def cost(tag,msgs,mt=200):
    b=json.dumps({"model":"glm-5.3_flash_uncensored","messages":msgs,"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
        headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {K}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as x: d=json.load(x)
    u=d.get('usage',{}); nm=d.get('nomask',{})
    print(f"{tag:38} prompt={u.get('prompt_tokens',0):6} compl={u.get('completion_tokens',0):4} cost=${nm.get('cost_usd',0):.6f}")
    return nm.get('cost_usd',0)
c1=cost("chat pendek ('hi')",[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
# simulasi prompt agen LightVela: system prompt besar
big="You are Hermes, an AI agent. "*400
c2=cost("chat + system prompt besar",[{"role":"system","content":big},{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
# simulasi riwayat panjang (10 pesan)
hist=[{"role":"user","content":"pertanyaan "*100},{"role":"assistant","content":"jawaban "*100}]*5
c3=cost("riwayat 10 pesan panjang",hist+[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
print()
print(f"rasio prompt-besar vs pendek: {c2/c1:.0f}x")
print(f"perkiraan chat sampai habis $1 (prompt besar): {int(1/c2):,}")
PY
